The '''Imperial Mark IV Sentinel Droid''' was a type of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] used by the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A number of Mark IV Sentinels were among the Imperial forces stationed at the [[Taral V Imperial fortress|Imperial base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taral V]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Mark IV Sentinel Droid is a type of enemy encountered in the Flashpoint "Taral V" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
